overview_description.description: FODEL offers a network of pick-up locations as an alternative to home delivery. It is the GCC's first technology platform that helps online shoppers receive their parcels faster, cheaper and at a place and time most convenient to them. FODEL connects e-commerce companies, logistics providers and local merchants which act as pick-up locations, to optimise the last mile delivery.
